metadata.name: GetShippingAddress
metadata.description: This API is used to get the shipping address and related details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:XXXXX Example:abc2123

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:John J Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ShippingAddressLine1
children.description: Shipping address line 1. Example: 2354 Main road Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ShippingAddressLine2
children.description: Shipping address line 2 Example:xyz Avenue Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ShippingCity
children.description: Shipping address city name Example: chicago Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

children.name: ShippingState
children.description: Sate of the shipping address Example: PK Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

children.name: ShippingCountry
children.description: Shipping address Country name Format: USA Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

children.name: ShippingPostalCode
children.description: Zip code of the shipping address. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

children.name: ShippingStatus
children.description: Status of Card Shipping. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format:XXX Example:ABC, AB12 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ShipmentDate
children.description: Shipping Date Valid Values:MM/DD/YYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/24/2019 07:25:12

children.name: ShippingMethod
children.description: Client's shipment menthod. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ShippingMethodID
children.description: Unique ID of shipping method Valid Values:0-9 a-z

children.name: ShippingMethodDescription
children.description: Description of Shipment. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abcd Allowable Values: 200

children.name: ProgramName
children.description: Name of Program. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:xxxx Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ProgramID
children.description: Unique ID of Program. Valid Values: 0-9

children.name: DeliveryMechanism
children.description: Shipment delivery mechanism. Valid Values:a-z Format:xxxx Example:(Overnight, Priority or Standard) Allowable Values: 40

children.name: DeliveryDate
children.description: Date when card is delivered to the card holder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: TrackingNumber
children.description: Shipment Tracking Number. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example:1234ab25 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: OrderedOnDate
children.description: Date when shipment is ordered. Valid Values:0-9 Format:mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example:02/20/2020 20:20:20

children.name: ClientProgramID
children.description: Client's Program ID Valid Values:0-9 Format:xxxx Example:1234 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ErrorReason
children.description: Provides reason of error if record is present in Bad Data/Error file. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format:XXX Example:Product Id Missing

children.name: ShippedONDate
children.description: Date when card is shipped on. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05
